title: Motion (Rodriguez – Blumenfield) relative to the Chief Legislative Analyst, with the assistance of the City Administrative Officer, Los Angeles Housing…
text:
[Council File 26-0673]
Motion (Rodriguez – Blumenfield) relative to the Chief Legislative Analyst, with the assistance of the City Administrative Officer, Los Angeles Housing Department, and the Los Angeles Homeless Service Authority, to report on the impacts of the County’s Department of Homeless Services and Housing becoming the lead of the region's Continuum of Care and the Coordinated Entry System.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion requesting a report on the impacts of the County's Department of Homeless Services and Housing becoming the regional lead for the Continuum of Care and Coordinated Entry System.

outcome.text: Housing and Homelessness Committee approved as amended (Aug 5, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Aug 19, 2026); Council action final
